title: Global Seismicity Atlas
description: An open, reproducible world map of earthquake-catalogue statistics built from free global catalogues (ISC-GEM and USGS ComCat): magnitude of completeness (Mc) and its change over time, Gutenberg-Richter b-value with 95 % intervals and quality codes, ISC-GEM vs ComCat consistency, and Omori-Utsu parameters for major aftershock sequences since 1990. Includes the analysis code, the website data files and the validation against published values. Descriptive catalogue statistics for research and education: not an earthquake forecast and not a seismic hazard map. Live site: https://seismicityatlas.org/
notes: Licences: the code (scripts, site code, tests) is MIT; the data and figures (site/data, docs/img, results) are CC BY-SA 4.0. The deposit as a whole is labelled CC BY-SA 4.0, the stricter of the two. The data are derived from the ISC-GEM Global Instrumental Earthquake Catalogue, (c) International Seismological Centre and GEM Foundation, CC BY-SA 3.0, as served by USGS ComCat (catalog=iscgem). Exceptions: plates.geojson is PB2002 (Bird 2003) under ODC-BY 1.0; Natural Earth layers are public domain; slab2/ is USGS Slab2 under CC0 1.0; results/sci2_gem_hazard.json holds aggregate statistics computed from the GEM Global Seismic Hazard Map (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and is not covered by the CC BY-SA statement. Please also cite ISC (2026), ISC-GEM Earthquake Catalogue, doi:10.31905/D808B825; Storchak et al. 2013, 2015; Di Giacomo et al. 2018; and USGS ComCat.
